title: 一个团队，三个独立对话
scope: 情境示意 · 不是多人真实联调
narration: A captain and two researchers want to study the exposed surface of a protein. One member calculates in Science Pal, another works in Codex. Each has a useful agent, but their conversations are separate.
A file arrives in the group chat. Which input and method produced it? Is it the approved version? Before writing the report, someone must ask all over again.

title: 我们管理的是交接依据
scope: 产品机制 · 沿用原 Vibe-Git 操作顺序
narration: Vibe Git Research keeps a shared research protocol around those separate agents. Members propose their work, the team aligns the requirements, and the captain publishes the agreed tasks.
The next task receives an approved artifact together with its version and review evidence. A completed agent response alone is not enough to release a file downstream.

title: 沿用原界面，保留原贡献
scope: 历史界面素材 · 展示操作位置，不冒充本轮实跑
narration: The original project supplies the topology, captain permissions, proposals and change governance. Our teammate supplies the common agent interface, registry and execution adapters. We preserve those contributions.

Our extension connects Science Pal and adds research input checks, independent review, evidence recovery and approved result reuse. The product remains a general workflow, not a dedicated protein calculator.

title: 从界面进入：建项与发布
scope: 确定性模拟界面 · 不调用真实模型
narration: In the existing project controls, members bind their agents and save proposals. The captain uploads the input, checks its source, and confirms the method and acceptance rules before publishing.
The screen shown here is a labeled interface example. The next sections use exported records from a completed real run, rather than pretending that these pictures are one continuous live recording.

title: 真实问题：固定结构的表面积
scope: 已完成的真实 1CRN 案例 · 单操作者、单机
narration: For the real case, we use the public one C R N structure. The question is its solvent accessible surface area under a fixed geometric protocol: chain A, three hundred twenty seven heavy atoms, and forty six residues.

Science Pal's Biology environment executes the calculation with Biopython, one thousand sampling points and a one point four angstrom probe. This is actual tool execution, not just writing a scientific explanation.

title: 结果可比较，结论有边界
scope: 真实成果 + 预先独立 NumPy 参考
narration: The reported total is two thousand nine hundred sixty seven point six two square angstroms. It differs from the independent five thousand point NumPy reference by about zero point one nine percent, within the agreed two percent tolerance.

Codex checks the input, method, reference and sum. This is a geometric reproduction for one structure. It is not a new biological discovery, and these checks do not guarantee every scientific conclusion.

title: 数值通过，仍可能缺证据
scope: 真实 R1 · 首次评审退回
narration: The first calculation passes its numerical checks, but its delivery lacks version evidence and the original code. Codex rejects the handoff. Missing version evidence was planned; the missing code was not.
The operator retrieves the original script and tool log from the Science Pal conversation. This human intervention is part of the evidence record. We do not describe the workflow as fully unattended.

title: 补证复审，不重新执行上游
scope: 真实 R1 · 相同执行 ID、成果 ID 与哈希
narration: The captain submits supplementary evidence using the existing review action. Codex reviews again and approves. The calculation artifact, its identifier and its hash remain unchanged. Science Pal does not rerun that upstream task.
There are still two upstream reviews, and review itself can include independent calculations. We claim avoided upstream reruns, not zero review cost or proven overall savings.

title: 只改报告，保留获批计算
scope: 真实 R2 · 变更评审后复用
narration: Next, the captain requests a Chinese summary and two limitations in the report. Change review identifies only the report as affected. After alignment and publication, the approved surface calculation is carried into revision two.

Codex updates the report, and Science Pal reviews it. The upstream result and its approval are reused. A separate malformed review was retried without rerunning the report, and that failure remains in the record.

title: 错误后的下一步，要看得懂
scope: 当前界面走查 · 模拟执行器，非真实 1CRN 截图
narration: The same controls explain what is preserved and what action comes next. A method mismatch blocks release. Supplementary review preserves the result when eligible. A failed file read can be retried without starting a model.

These interface checks use a deterministic simulator. They support recovery behavior, not scientific results. The original dark topology, navigation, permissions and order of operations stay in place.

title: 证据完整，也公开失败和范围
scope: 修复后的成功项目 · 11 次 Agent 作业
narration: The successful project contains eleven agent jobs, thirty one original attachments and thirty four input receipts. The offline verifier checks file bytes and workflow identities. It does not independently repeat remote scientific computation.

An earlier misconfigured attempt remains separate. One operator used one computer and one Science Pal account. Cross computer collaboration and human time savings have not been established by this case.

title: 先看证据，再决定是否复用
scope: 功能冻结 dda4823 · 材料版本 final-20261031-v1
narration: The video page links to the five page brief, the evidence package and a public Science Pal verification replay. That replay is historical and read only; rerunning the full workflow requires your own accounts and local connectors.

Our contribution is a reliable handoff contract across agents: agree on the method, check the result, preserve the approval, and recover without unnecessary upstream reruns. Configuration effort and real user benefits still need measurement.
